item.description:
MeetMouse 0.38.0

  • Teams: one private page for your team's meeting notes. One person buys a team license ($40 once, unlimited seats, at meetmouse.com/team), creates the team in Settings → Team, and clicks "Invite people…". Joining unlocks MeetMouse on each teammate's Mac.
  • On a team, the notes for your new meetings (summary, topics, next steps) go to the team page on their own. Turn that off in Settings → Team, take any meeting off the page from its "Shared with team" menu, or add an older one with "Share with team". Transcripts and coaching stay on your Mac, and notes are encrypted before they leave it.
  • Import from Fireflies: paste your Fireflies API key in Settings and MeetMouse brings your Fireflies meetings (notes and transcripts) over as regular meetings. The key is used once and not saved.
